story.ch01.title: Paths Left Open
story.ch01.summary: The guided route exposes water marks, a supply note, and a stalled waterwheel record. The repair must account for people below the sanctuary.
story.ch01.s01.title: Marks Below the Shrine
story.ch01.s01.line_01: The upper mark is carved. The lower one is fresh chalk. A full handspan between them.
story.ch01.s01.line_02: For the Reedbank kitchens: two grain sacks delivered, one returned. Millers ask us not to send unmilled grain until the wheel turns again. Leave the gate unlatched for the evening carrier.
story.ch01.s01.line_03: A shrine can wait for rain. A kitchen cannot cook a delivery note.
story.ch01.s01.line_04: This rope was repaired recently. Someone is still carrying loads through here.
story.ch01.s01.line_05: I used to count sacks on these paths. I should have looked at where the water went.
story.ch01.s01.objective: Compare the water marks and read the supply note.
story.ch01.s01.journal: Reedbank’s wheel has stopped, grain deliveries are being returned, and the supply path remains in use. The lower water mark is well below the older carving.
story.ch01.s01.rope: A new knot joins two weathered lengths. The carrier has repaired the route rather than abandoned it.
story.ch01.s02.title: Room for a Carrier
story.ch01.s02.line_01: The supply frame is empty. No blood, no torn strap. Someone set it down and turned back.
story.ch01.s02.line_02: The roots move before they strike. Lan was right about the paving.
story.ch01.s02.line_03: Test outlet only. Turn once. Read the return channel. Close before leaving.
story.ch01.s02.line_04: The key turns easily. The water comes in fits, as if something farther on keeps catching it.
story.ch01.s02.line_05: I can clear a room. That does not tell me whether a loaded carrier can cross it tomorrow.
story.ch01.s02.objective: Clear the guided encounters, select a blessing, and test the inspection outlet.
story.ch01.s02.journal: The short route is passable again. The test outlet shows an interrupted return flow, and an abandoned supply frame suggests carriers have been turning back. I closed the inspection outlet after testing.
story.ch01.s02.blessing: Choose one blessing for this expedition. Blessings expire when the expedition ends.
story.ch01.s02.failure: The guided route is still available. Return to the entrance to try again; learned techniques are retained.
story.ch01.s02.shutter_closed: The inspection outlet is closed. The old pressure gauge still trembles.
story.ch01.s03.title: A Number with a Kitchen Behind It
story.ch01.s03.line_01: You brought the mark back at its real height. Most people draw a neat line and lose the measurement.
story.ch01.s03.line_02: The Reedbank wheel has stopped. Their kitchens are returning grain. The return channel only gives a trickle.
story.ch01.s03.line_03: This ledger has their last three winter readings. Lower every year. Here, here, and here. I kept sending the figures.
story.ch01.s03.line_05: Requests acknowledged. Review pending. Fine words to put beside a cold stove.
story.ch01.s03.line_06: The full route leads to the intake anchor. Go prepared. When its seal responds, read the pressure before you turn anything.
story.ch01.s03.objective: Report the downstream evidence to Lan and prepare for the full Bamboo expedition.
story.ch01.s03.journal: Reedbank’s water has declined for three winters. Lan’s requests remain pending. Repairing the intake now means checking its effect on the inhabited valley, not only filling our basin. The full Bamboo expedition and Ember Lance are available.
story.ch01.s03.choice_READINGS: I will bring back pressure readings, not just a clear path.
story.ch01.s03.response_READINGS: Write down when the needle jumps. A single number can hide a whole bad morning.
story.ch01.s03.choice_PEOPLE: Keep their note with the repair ledger.
story.ch01.s03.response_PEOPLE: It belongs there. I should have done that before you had to ask.
